_source_note: Detachments, DP costs and Force Dispositions match Wahapedia's 11th edition Orks page (Orks app v2.7.1, October 2026), read 2026-10-12. Rule text is a summary, not the printed wording.
_battleSizes_note: Core rules 25.03. The points limit picks the battle size: the first entry whose maxPoints is not below the limit, else the last one. dp = Detachment Points, enhancements = Enhancement limit, unitLimit = copies of one datasheet (doubled for BATTLELINE and DEDICATED TRANSPORT, always 1 for an EPIC HERO). soloDp: at that size ONE detachment of exactly this cost may be taken as the army's only detachment even though it exceeds dp.

war-horde.name: War Horde
war-horde._category_note: War Horde carries TWO Force Dispositions, so category is an array here. Every other detachment has one.
war-horde._grants_note: A weapon ability for every ORKS unit, so it is a grantsWeaponAbilities entry and shows as a dashed badge on melee weapon rows.
war-horde.ruleDescription: Get Stuck In: Melee attacks made by friendly ORKS units have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

green-tide.name: Green Tide
green-tide._grants_note: Only the BOYZ half is unconditional, so only that half is a grant. The Lethal Hits half depends on having charged this turn and stays in the rule text.
green-tide.ruleDescription:
Mob-handed Brutality:
• Melee attacks made by friendly BOYZ units have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
• If a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit made a Charge move this turn, its melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].

bully-boyz.name: Bully Boyz
bully-boyz._grants_note: MEGANOBZ or NOBZ — either keyword qualifies, hence anyKeyword.
bully-boyz.ruleDescription: Displays of Savagery: Melee attacks made by friendly MEGANOBZ and NOBZ units have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

runt-swarm.name: Runt Swarm
runt-swarm.ruleDescription:
Sneaky Little Gitz:
• Friendly GRETCHIN units have BATTLELINE.
• When a friendly GRETCHIN unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move, that move does not stop it from starting an action.

shoota-boyz.name: Shoota Boyz
shoota-boyz._grants_note: The [ASSAULT] half is unconditional and is a grant. The +3" Range half only applies while riled up, which the app does not track per unit, so it stays in the rule text.
shoota-boyz._whileCalled_note: whileCalled: what this rule adds for a unit that is riled up by the Waaagh!. `text` is listed on matching unit cards and in the banner (`who` names the units there); rangedWeapon / meleeWeapon add to weapon stats on the card.
shoota-boyz.ruleDescription:
Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!: Ranged attacks made by friendly ORKS INFANTRY units have:
• [ASSAULT].
• +3" Range while the unit is riled up.

taktikal-brigade.name: Taktikal Brigade
taktikal-brigade.ruleDescription:
Suspiciously Well Organised:
• Friendly STORMBOYZ units have BATTLELINE.
• When a friendly BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make a Fall Back move, that move does not stop it from declaring a charge.

wreckas.name: Wreckas
wreckas._grants_note: Depends on objective range, which is board state — no grant, rule text only.
wreckas.ruleDescription:
Wreckin’ and Lootin’: In your Shooting phase, when a friendly BREAKA BOYZ, FLASH GITZ or TANKBUSTAS unit is selected to shoot, its attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 if either of these is true:
• The unit is within range of an objective.
• The target of the attack is within range of an objective.

da-big-hunt.name: Da Big Hunt
da-big-hunt._grants_note: Depends on what the attack targets, so there is nothing to put on a weapon row — rule text only.
da-big-hunt.ruleDescription: Da Hunt is On: Attacks made by friendly BEAST SNAGGA units that target a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit have +1 AP.

madcap-meks.name: Madcap Meks
madcap-meks._stratagem_note: This detachment's single stratagem (Vindictive Artillerists) is printed inside its Detachment Rules block on the source page rather than under a Stratagems heading. It lives in data/stratagems.json like any other.
madcap-meks.ruleDescription:
Unpredictable Genius: In your Shooting phase, when every ranged attack made by a friendly BIG MEK, MEK GUNZ, MORKANAUT or WAZBOM BLASTAJET unit targets the same enemy unit, roll one D6:

D6 — RESULT
• 1 — Dat’s Weird: the target has a 4+ invulnerable save until your unit has shot.
• 2-3 — Hop Splat: select one other enemy unit within 3" of the target; it suffers D3 mortal wounds.
• 4 — Seekerz: those attacks have +1 to Hit rolls.
• 5 — Lifted: until your unit has shot, the target has FLY and cannot have the Benefit of Cover.
• 6 — Runtified: the target has -1 T until your unit has shot.

dread-mob.name: Dread Mob
dread-mob._grants_note: Rolled fresh each time a unit attacks — nothing unconditional to grant. The app prints the table; it does not roll or track it.
dread-mob.ruleDescription:
Try Dat Button!: In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding TITANIC units) is selected to attack, you can press the button. If you do, roll either one D6 or two D6 (re-rolling duplicate results); the unit’s attacks gain each result rolled:

D6 — RESULT
• 1-2 — +1 A
• 3-4 — +2 S
• 5-6 — +1 AP

If you rolled two D6, the unit makes one hazard roll after it has attacked.

blitz-brigade.name: Blitz Brigade
blitz-brigade._keyword_note: WAGON is a printed datasheet keyword in the current rules (Battlewagon, Gunwagon and others carry it), so nothing has to be granted for the two WAGON Upgrades to match.
blitz-brigade.ruleDescription:
Unstoppable Momentum:
• Friendly WAGON units can re-roll Charge rolls.
• When a friendly WAGON unit is selected to make an Advance move, it can change its Advance roll to a 6.

kult-of-speed.name: Kult of Speed
kult-of-speed._grants_note: The SPEED FREEKS half applies to every such unit whenever it Advances or Falls Back, so it is shown as an ability badge on their cards.
kult-of-speed.ruleDescription:
Adrenaline Junkies:
• Friendly WARBIKERS units have BATTLELINE.
• When a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move: its ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until the end of the turn, and that move does not stop it from declaring a charge.

flyboyz.name: Flyboyz

whileCalled.text: +1 to Hit rolls for ranged attacks

flyboyz.ruleDescription:
Skyborne Loons:
• Friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT units do not count towards the combined points value of your Strategic Reserves units.
• While a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT or DEFFKOPTAS unit is riled up, its ranged attacks have +1 to Hit rolls.

brute-bosses.name: Brute Bosses
brute-bosses._rule_note: Named ’Ard as Nails — the same name as the Combat Patrol detachment in data/combat-patrol/index.json (id ard-as-nails). They are unrelated; the ids differ on purpose.
brute-bosses._grants_note: Applies to every WARBOSS model, so it is shown as an ability badge on their cards. This detachment has no stratagems.
brute-bosses.ruleDescription: ’Ard as Nails: When a friendly WARBOSS model is destroyed, if its unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if that unit is riled up. On a 3+ the model is not removed yet: it stays on the battlefield until its unit has fought or the phase ends, whichever comes first.

wurrband.name: Wurrband
wurrband._grants_note: Applies to every ORKS PSYKER model, so it is shown as an ability badge on their cards. This detachment has no stratagems.
wurrband.ruleDescription:
Powers of da Waaagh!: [PSYCHIC] attacks made by friendly ORKS PSYKER models have +1 S, and a further +1 S for every 5 models in that model’s unit (or embarked within that model).

Friendly ORKS PSYKER models also have these psychic abilities:

Roar of Mork (psychic level 1): in your Movement phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for it (one D6). If you do:
• On a 1, this unit is Battle-shocked.
• Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) within 12". It makes a Battle-shock roll, with -1 for every 10 models in this unit.

Visions of Violence (psychic level 1): at the start of the Fight phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for it (one D6). If you do:
• On a 1, this unit is Battle-shocked.
• This unit has Fights First.

Psychic levels are spent against the unit’s psyker level each battle round — see Unstable Energies.
